title: Isolation of Natural Dye from Codiaeum Variegatum
author: Khalida Tasneem
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Grind dried leaves to powder
steps.instruction: Obtain dried leaves of Codiaeum Variegatum and grind them into a fine powder.

steps.title: Reflux leaf powder with alcohol
steps.instruction: Place the powdered leaves in a suitable flask, add enough alcohol to cover them, and reflux for 12 hours.

steps.title: Filter and evaporate solvent
steps.instruction: After reflux, filter the mixture to remove solid residues, then evaporate the filtrate in a rotary evaporator under reduced pressure to obtain a solid natural dye.

steps.title: Prepare mordant solutions
steps.instruction: For each mordant (copper sulphate, ferrous sulphate, potassium dichromate), prepare a solution containing either 10 % or 20 % (w/w) of the mordant relative to the weight of the wool to be dyed.

steps.title: Boil wool with dye and mordant
steps.instruction: Combine the wool, the solid natural dye, and the chosen mordant solution, then boil the mixture for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash dyed wool
steps.instruction: Rinse the boiled wool thoroughly with water to remove excess dye and mordant.

steps.title: Dry wool in shade
steps.instruction: Dry the washed wool in shade at room temperature until completely dry.
